rubric_content.text_property: Every custom solution in the deck (an on-ground activation, contest, event, mystery shopper, campus or school programme, influencer programme or microsite) has a slide of its own giving concrete specifics: where it runs (named cities, districts or venue types, with counts), how it works, its scale, its timing, and how it is proved or reported.
Figures the agent assumed rather than found (counts, cities, durations, reach) are marked as indicative or assumed, and no assumed figure is presented as a researched fact or given a source.

Neither the deck nor the reply gives a price, rate, discount or cost split for HT's media or activations; commercials are left to HT's pricing team. Mentioning the client's own budget or product price is fine.
Every statistic on a stat-row slide names its source on that slide and matches a finding the research tools returned in this conversation.

The deck reads as one argument: brief, insight, big idea, the components of the solution, each component in detail, the plan, then why this works; and its headings state each slide's point rather than a generic label like 'Overview' or 'Strategic Pillars'.
The reply says which sources were checked, which returned nothing, and what could not be established, rather than implying everything was found.
Before building the deck, the agent searched HT's past decks from at least three different angles (for example the client, the category, the objective, the audience or a format).
Before building the deck, the agent researched the client's recent campaigns or news and at least one named competitor.
The agent called lookup_deck before build_solution_deck.

Any url passed to fetch_url, and any client_website passed to build_solution_deck, is on a site (the same domain or a subdomain of it) that appears in the email or in an earlier tool result; going to that site's home page or another page on it is fine, but no site is guessed from the company's name.
If build_solution_deck returned problems, the agent fixed every one and built again, rather than stopping, truncating text or reporting a deck that was never published.

deck_quality_gate.description: A deck was published with HT's logo on the cover and at least three generated images.

no_competitor_sources.description: No competitor publication's link in the research results, the deck or the reply.

component_names_consistent.description: Share of the overview slide's cards that reappear word for word as a later slide's eyebrow.
